title: Community BBQ
description: Monthly community gathering with a free sausage sizzle, kids activities and a chance to meet your neighbours at Akuna Vista Park.

title: Twilight Markets
description: An evening of local food stalls, live music and handmade goods from Akuna Vista makers and small businesses.

title: Kids Movie Night
description: An outdoor family movie screening on the big lawn — bring a picnic blanket and enjoy a free family film under the stars.

title: Community Working Bee
description: Help spruce up the community garden beds and walking trail — tools and morning tea provided, all ages welcome.

title: Winter Fun Run
description: A 5km community fun run around The Ponds wetlands, followed by coffee and pastries at a nearby café.
